security.classification: Internal use only — DEC-012 (security/privacy authority Brett, 2026-10-08): no PII and no CJI/CJIS data will be stored in the system, interpreted per DEC-017 (2026-10-09) as excluding sensitive PII (DOB, SSN, driver's license) and CJI while accepting basic identity/contact fields needed for clearance tracking.
security.sensitiveData: No sensitive PII or CJI — DEC-012 as interpreted by DEC-017. SPRINT-002 verification (2026-10-08): the committed prototype contains no DOB/SSN/driver's-license fields anywhere; app.js strips them from legacy records and database-schema.sql documents their intentional exclusion. DEC-017 (security/privacy authority Brett, 2026-10-09): applicant name, phone, email, notes, and document-upload fields are kept as-is and accepted as in-scope. FIND-001 CLOSED. No applicant records exist in the repository.
security.authentication: DEC-015 (security/privacy authority Brett, 2026-10-08): production direction is City SSO (Entra ID) with server-side role-based access mirroring the three view levels (Limited/Records/Admin), targeted at a future release. Prototype local PINs are never production controls.
security.authorization: TBD. Prototype has three local views (Limited, Records, Full Admin); production model undecided.
security.secretsManagement: No credentials, tokens, personal information, or production secrets in repository files (Rule 50).
security.supplyChain: No external dependencies currently. Additions require trusted-source decisions and recorded SP 800-204D practices.
security.loggingAudit: TBD — required for production per prototype README; no decision recorded.
security.testingExpectations: Rule 40 categories; required/not-required decisions pending security/privacy authority.
security.vulnerabilityContact: TBD — owner must designate intake path, severity method, response and disclosure expectations.

ssdf-1.1.notes: DEC-016: applies to development practices (reviewed change, no secrets in repo, dependency controls per Rule 50).

sp-800-218a.notes: DEC-016: no delivered AI system; AI-assisted coding alone does not trigger the profile.

sp-800-204d.notes: DEC-016: trusted-source expectations only; no CI/CD or external dependencies exist. Expand the profile when a pipeline or dependencies are introduced.
